# pipeline
stage1 = source()              # emits unbounded stream
stage2 = transform(stage1)     # consumes ALL of stage1 in memory

# PATCH 2024-03: wrap stage2 in try — crashes stopped (see repair-log #2)
try:
    result = stage2.run()
except:
    result = partial(stage2.last_batch)   # symptom fix: skip failing batch
    log("swallowed stage2 failure")

stage3 = publish(result)
